$note: 財帛宮（2026-10-12）：破軍.財帛。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 財帛宮 p.436–462。倒閉、破產、官非、盜賊、火災、疾病一類斷語不用；金額、「巨富」一類保證不用；天刑、天月、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用。

rules.text: 破軍化祿，你要身兼幾份工作或幾門生意來賺錢。
rules.en: Po Jun in Abundance: you make money by holding several jobs or lines of business at once.

rules.text: 破軍在財帛宮不擅理財，擅長開創財源；財源也來自多方面。
rules.en: With Po Jun in your Wealth Palace, managing money is not your strength; your nature is to open new sources, and income comes from several directions.

rules.text: 破軍坐財帛，你多數要轉換行業，然後才能致富。
rules.en: With Po Jun in the palace, you usually need to change line of work before you prosper.

source.quote: 多主转变行业然后始能致富
